program.target: self.root / human-surface Frank v0.1 fully operational on accepted Hostinger Ubuntu VPS

hypotheses.claim: Presence fencing is insufficient unless each consequential effect attempt is bound to and revalidated against the current global execution lease epoch.
The sole production physical execution gate may make stale effect attempts unreachable, making an extra effect-layer lease check redundant.
hypotheses.falsifier: Zombie attempt built under epoch A wakes after epoch B is admitted and reaches any consequential effect transition without stale-epoch rejection.

out_of_box_experiment.basis: current V15 acquire expiry rule plus current repository clock-warp falsifier
out_of_box_experiment.candidate: Use Linux CLOCK_BOOTTIME/monotone deadline for same-boot lease TTL, retain UTC for audit, treat boot-id change as explicit recovery boundary.
out_of_box_experiment.counterhypothesis: UTC may remain operationally adequate if accepted target wall clock never performs material discontinuous steps; target clock discipline and recovery behavior still require measurement.

external_primary_evidence.finding: monotonic clock is not affected by system clock updates; CLOCK_BOOTTIME includes suspend time on Linux
CLOCK_BOOTTIME is monotonic, suspend-aware, and avoids CLOCK_REALTIME discontinuities
lease-backed locks/fencing can gate transactional updates while ownership remains current
stable workload/self identity, credential/identity document, invocation/instance identity and build provenance are separable dimensions

required_changes: Bind execution_id and execution_lease_epoch into EffectReservationReceipt and EffectAttempt.

Reject missing/stale execution epochs before COMMITTING/EXECUTED side effects.
Preserve uncertain-outcome reconciliation semantics so fencing never incorrectly makes an already-executed external effect safe to retry.
Measure a same-boot CLOCK_BOOTTIME/boot-id lease candidate against V15 UTC baseline and physical flock gate before schema promotion.
